title: UCLA weather — schemas in use
description: Schemas reachable from the operations of the UCLA contract of the same name. Extracted from the contract UCLA publishes on its own developer portal; the source document carries a large shared SIS definition library of which only these are referenced by any path.

wind_direction.description: Average direction from which wind blows during the previous 60 seconds in degrees from due North.

wind_speed.description: Average wind speed during the previous 60 seconds in miles per hour.

gust.description: Maximum wind speed during the previous 60 seconds in miles per hour.

air_temp.description: Current air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit.

min_temp.description: Minimum temperature since midnight PST in degrees Fahrenheit.

max_temp.description: Maximum temperature since midnight PST in degrees Fahrenheit.

min_rel_humid.description: Minimum relative humidity since midnight PST in percent.

max_rel_humid.description: Maximum relative humidity since midnight PST in percent.

dew_point.description: Current dew point temperature in degrees Fahrenheit.

wet_bulb.description: Current wet bulb temperature in degrees Fahrenheit.

sea_level_pressure.description: Equivalent sea level pressure in millibars.

datetime.description: Date and time of data publication.
